sql: with o as (select lo.id, lo.kalshi_order_id, lo.market_ticker, lo.created_at from live_orders lo where lo.strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and lo.side='no' and lo.action='buy' and lo.status='filled' and lo.limit_price between 90 and 95 and lo.created_at >= '2026-07-01'), f as (select fl.kalshi_order_id, min(fl.filled_at) as filled_at from fills fl where fl.filled_at >= '2026-07-01' and fl.kalshi_order_id in (select kalshi_order_id from o) group by 1), m as (select o.market_ticker, min(date_trunc('month', o.created_at))::date as mon, min(extract(epoch from (f.filled_at - coalesce(c.submitted_at,o.created_at)))/60.0) as wait_min, min(c.spread) as spread from o join f on f.kalshi_order_id=o.kalshi_order_id left join execution_order_context c on c.live_order_id=o.id group by 1), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl, coalesce(quantity_fp,quantity) as pos from positions where captured_at >= '2026-07-01' and market_ticker in (select market_ticker from m) order by market_ticker, captured_at desc) select mon, 'wait' as dim, case when wait_min<30 then 'a <30m' when wait_min<120 then 'b 30-120m' else 'c 2h+' end as bucket, count(*) as mkts, sum((p.realized_pnl<0)::int) as losers, round(sum(p.realized_pnl)*100/count(*),1) as cents_per_mkt from m join p using (market_ticker) where p.pos=0 group by 1,2,3 union all select mon, 'spread', case when spread is null then 'z ?' when spread<=1 then 'a 1c' else 'b 2c+' end, count(*), sum((p.realized_pnl<0)::int), round(sum(p.realized_pnl)*100/count(*),1) from m join p using (market_ticker) where p.pos=0 group by 1,2,3 order by 2,1,3
